user.title: Recipe Library
user.description: Set up the recipe library? Recipes are stored locally in Home Assistant and are available to all Home Assistant users.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Recipe Library is already set up. Only one library is possible.

init.title: AI settings
init.description: Choose which AI Task entity does which kind of import. Leave a field empty to use the preferred AI Task entity of Home Assistant (Settings > System > AI). The content you import is sent to the provider behind the entity you choose.

data_description.ai_text: Reads recipes from web pages and pasted text. Needs an entity that can generate data.
data_description.ai_image: Reads recipes from screenshots and photos, for example of a cookbook page. Needs an entity that accepts attachments.
data_description.ai_video: Reads recipes from videos. Needs an entity that accepts attachments; whether it understands video depends on the provider.
